description: §19.4.3 — a VALUE-form recovery arm on a cell-assigned failable SERVER call: `@result = risky(-1) !{ | .Boom(m) :> "recovered: " + m }`. The stub answers the Boom envelope; the arm's value lands in @result, and the statement after the handler reads it (`saw recovered: neg`). The server-escalated twin of error/handler-recovery-into-cell (which covers the client-local callee).
rationale: §19.4.3: a non-escalating arm produces a value that becomes the result of the guarded expression; for `@cell = call() !{…}` that value is written into the cell (never the raw envelope). §13.2: the server call is awaited at its call site, so the recovery happens before the next statement reads @result.
